name: the-cave
title: The Cave
author: behroozzx
description:
You are trapped in a vast underground cave, where all progression takes place.

Configure independent scenario features from Settings > Mod Settings > Startup. Train Interiors can be combined with Cave Collapses, Advancing Collapse and any Digging Mode level. Train Interiors and Shelter Defense remain mutually exclusive.

The Cave supports both normal Factorio and Space Age, including Train Interiors, Shelter Defense, CAVETORIO, Advancing Collapse, Cave Collapses and Digging Mode.
